purpose: Prove the walker is HONESTLY BLIND to a closed shadow root - it captures nothing from inside it and fabricates nothing - and that OPAQUE_JS positively NAMES the blind spot instead of leaving a silently clean scan.
targeted_defect: None (regression guard). This fixture pins the anti-green-wash contract: a surface the DOM cannot read must become a named ledger row, never an empty pass. A future 'improvement' that guessed at closed-shadow contents would break this fixture.
